name: Electric Haul Trucks
description: Pilot conversion of diesel haul trucks to battery-electric haul trucks, reducing diesel combustion but increasing purchased electricity demand for charging.
control_variable: Fraction of haulage fleet converted to electric (pilot scale)
assumptions: Effect fractions are applied to the mine's own Scope 1 / Scope 2 baselines. At full pilot deployment: diesel-related Scope 1 reduced ~26.7% of baseline Scope 1; purchased electricity for charging increases Scope 2 by ~13.5% of baseline Scope 2. Net effect = Scope1 reduction minus Scope2 increase, calculated by the carbon engine, never summed as an isolated percentage.
feasibility_notes: Charging infrastructure and grid capacity assumed available at pilot scale; not independently verified for any specific mine site.

name: Idle-Time Reduction System
description: Automatic engine shutoff / idle-management systems fitted to diesel mobile equipment to cut wasted idle-time fuel consumption.
control_variable: Fraction of diesel fleet fitted with idle-management systems
assumptions: Reduces diesel-related Scope 1 emissions only; no Scope 2 interaction modeled for this intervention.
feasibility_notes: Low operational disruption; typically fast to deploy.

name: Fleet Telematics & Driver Behaviour
description: Telematics devices and driver-coaching program to reduce fuel waste from harsh acceleration, excess idling and inefficient routing behaviour.
control_variable: Fraction of fleet fitted with telematics
feasibility_notes: Requires driver training and change-management; benefit realized gradually.

name: Haul-Route Optimization
description: Software-based optimization of in-pit haul routes and truck dispatch to reduce total haul distance and fuel burn per tonne moved.
control_variable: Fraction of haul network covered by optimized routing/dispatch
feasibility_notes: Depends on pit geometry and dispatch system integration; assumed feasible across full network at prototype scale.

name: Solar / Renewable Electricity
description: On-site or contracted renewable electricity (solar) to displace grid electricity used for pumps, conveyors, processing and site load.
control_variable: Fraction of purchased electricity displaced by renewable supply
assumptions: Reduces Scope 2 emissions directly by displacing grid electricity at the stated fraction of baseline Scope 2. Negative scope2_delta indicates a Scope 2 reduction.
feasibility_notes: Assumes land/rooftop availability and grid interconnection; capital-intensive relative to the operational-efficiency interventions.

name: Methane Capture & Utilization
description: Capture of fugitive methane (where geologically present) for flaring or utilization, reducing the CH4 component of Scope 1.
assumptions: Effect limited to the fugitive-methane share of Scope 1 baseline; most mines have a comparatively small fugitive component in this dataset.
feasibility_notes: Applicability depends on seam gassiness; assumed technically feasible at prototype scale only.

name: Road-to-Rail Logistics Shift
description: Shift of coal/material outbound logistics from road transport to rail, reducing Scope 3 transport emissions.
control_variable: Fraction of road-transport tonne-km shifted to rail
assumptions: Reduces the transport-related share of Scope 3 baseline at the stated fraction; does not affect commuting-related Scope 3.
feasibility_notes: Requires rail siding access; assumed available at prototype scale only.
